modules.module_title: Prepare the work plan and allocate resources using ERP

pcs.pc_description: Obtain details of vessel docking plans, cargo and container movement plans, etc. from ERP.
Develop daily work plan factoring in priority cases, time-bound requirements, special handling requirements, etc using ERP.
Get the work plan approved by the yard manager or CFS/ICD manager and allocate tasks to subordinates.
Budget and allocate the requisite MHE for tasks at hand.
Inspect the yard for markings/demarcation, storage and cleanliness per safety norms.
Monitor cargo loading, unloading and movement operations.
Engage resources in alternate operations when there is a delay in planned operations.
Allocate additional and ad-hoc staffing and equipment during exigency.
Escalate issues regarding MHE operations, transporter delays, vessel delays, accidents, damages, etc., to the manager.
Provide corrective and preventive action plans based on accident and damage reports.
Liaise with port officials, customs officials and external stakeholders.
Conduct periodic inspections of the yard for cleanliness, usage of PPEs, adherence to SOP and ensure regulations and norms for the workforce are followed.
Ensure cargo bays are marked, segregated and containers, cargo are stored per prescribed norms.
Check parking and positioning of equipment as per SOP.
Ensure all necessary precautions for storing hazardous cargo are complied with, and emergency services are available.
Schedule maintenance of MHE and equipment if required.
Prepare an inspection report highlighting any anomalies or changes, any deviation from SOP etc. and submit as required.

pcs.pc_description: Review the yard and bay space utilisation by cargo, container and data from ERP regarding open and closed yards, dry bulk cargo vs container, etc. and assess available storage capacity.
Review the ageing of different containers and cargo that have come onto the port / CFS and are due for movement to the CFS/ client, respectively.
Identify reasons for delay and check reasons for over or under-utilisation of yard space by conducting meetings with yard staff and taking corrective action.
Recommend the implementation of an AI- integrated centralised portal of information like an Intelligent Rack Storing System for efficient yard planning to the management.

modules.module_title: Assess storage requirements of incoming cargo and vessel berthing

pcs.pc_description: Obtain details from ERP for the vessel berthing plan and cargo loading and unloading plan into the CFS, ICD.
Coordinate with the vessel docking supervisor/ transport supervisor, vessel officer and cargo surveyor to get a go-ahead for cargo/ container loading/ unloading.
Check if the yard has the appropriate capacity to handle the incoming cargo.
Adjust by shipping out aged cargo onto the CFS, shipper or exporting the cargo onto the vessel (port in case of CFS).
Identify and finalise yards and bays for storage of incoming cargo, considering the various demarcations and precautions to be taken, particularly for hazardous and dry bulk cargo.
Prepare a schedule in ERP for vessel docking, including berth availability, priority cargo, perishable cargo, resource availability, etc.
Prepare cargo storage plans based on the vessel berthing plan and get them approved by the terminal manager.
Obtain a sign off from the manager and communicate to the shipper, port authority, vessel and cargo handling supervisor.
Communicate the vessel docking plan/ cargo storage plan to the cargo handlers, lifting supervisors and vessel planners.
Address the queries of shipping lines and agents regarding cargo operations and storage.
Check that all cargo handling activities executed are as per schedule and SOP.
Communicate regarding amendments and delays, if any, as and when required.
Document damages to cargo/ container during loading/ unloading.
Provide guidance and resolve/escalate any issues faced in loading/ unloading.
Check that all cargo is stored at the yard's planned/allocated storage location.
Escalate issues to the terminal manager if required.

modules.module_title: Coordinate for timely movement of cargo

pcs.pc_description: Obtain vessel information related to docking schedule, berth, bays and containers to be unloaded/ loaded from vessel transporters and shippers to move cargo to and from the CFS/ICD.
Communicate and finalise cargo movement plan with lifting supervisors, vessel supervisors, cargo equipment handlers, and manual cargo handlers.
Oversee cargo movement from the port terminal, CFS via rail and road lines and export via vessels.
Review cargo movement documentation and ensure correctness.
Prepare a report on cargo storage plans, their adherence, cargo movement plans and cargo ageing.

pcs.pc_description: Coordinate with shipping liners, vessel operators, freight transporters, importers and exporters, and the port authorities to obtain requisite cargo documents.
Review documentation of transport vehicles and their certificates for fitness for operation, presence of requisite license, etc.
Review cargo documents like bill of lading, shipping bills, PGA (Participative Government Agencies) clearances, etc., for compliance with regulations and standards.
Prepare and review storage plans and yard layout to check for compliances, particularly regarding hazardous and reefer cargo.
Review fitness certificates and related documents regarding operations of various MHEs, cranes and terminal equipment.
Review and approve gate entry and exit passes for transporter's vehicles.
Prepare and review compliance reports regarding yard and terminal layout, fitness of equipment and personnel, various incidents, cargo handling, etc.
Respond to and resolve queries raised by port and customs authorities, customs brokers, shipping liners, clients, and transporters regarding the status of different shipments.
Coordinate between the vessel, shipper/ importer, agents and port authorities to ensure that all compliances and requirements are met.
Obtain safe and secured go-ahead from the cargo surveyor upon completion of loading/ unloading activities.
Collect counter signature from transporter for actuals received or dispatched.
Check consignments received against order and delivery documentation to confirm that the cargo's quality, quantity and condition are acceptable, identifying and referring any discrepancies.
Maintain records relating to cargo receipt/storage/dispatch, ensuring that these are up-to-date and complete.
Check if receipt and delivery are documented in ERP.
Prepare daily reports highlighting the cargo storage and movement, plan vs actual performance, cargo ageing, and details of accidents and damages, if any.
Review escalated issues and identify the root cause for providing corrective action.
Provide technical guidance to the team for execution.
Escalate the issues to the manager when external or additional help is required.
Coordinate with other departments, transporters, freight operators, port authorities, shipping companies and others to resolve required escalations.

pcs.pc_description: Implement IOT-based solutions for the data to be directly transferred from RFID scanners and sensors to ERP.
Login to IOT applications/ software to analyse the data transmitted.
Obtain details of all containers moving in and out of the CFS, including container number, cargo content, destination, shipper and vessel details, date of servicing, etc.
Cross-verify container status based on physical inspection report and yard utilisation report.
Correct the information in the shipment tracking ERP.

modules.module_title: Track the position of consignments and containers globally using GIS

pcs.pc_description: • Collect complete tracking identifiers listed below from carriers: • Transport means identifiers (e.g., IMO vessel number). • Transport equipment identifiers (e.g., shipping container). • Identifier of all cargo carried by a transporter means for a specific transport movement (i.e., manifest).
Check the cargo’s real time position using GIS Based Cargo Tracking system.
Track the container's position using smart supply chain and ERP by feeding the Container index number.
Extract information regarding present location, shipper details, cargo content, estimated date of arrival at destination, etc.
Estimate equipment and workforce requirements considering the type of cargo, stuffing/destuffing/packing requirement based on location and route.
Prepare detailed documentation and present the analysis to the CFS or ICD manager.
Highlight any accidents, issues in tracking, etc.
Suggest corrective action in case of container packing or sealing errors that have led to damage or accidents.

pcs.pc_description: Track the status of different containers in the ERP, their ageing and damage reports.
Analyse the data from reports/ ERP and forecast the schedule of predictive container maintenance.
Have the predictive container maintenance schedule programmed in ERP.
Extract the report generated for predictive maintenance and schedule accordingly.

modules.module_title: Identify containers for maintenance using manual methods

pcs.pc_description: Obtain information related to the container's health, date of last servicing, ageing since then, number of cycles completed, accidents, damages, previous damage reports, if any, etc.
Analyse the information to identify ailing containers that need to be put for servicing and repair.
Conduct physical verification of containers in the yard for damages and service ageing.
Identify the containers that require service or repairs and segregate them.
Post identification, update the service or repair requirement status in ERP and mark them out of service.
Contact the service and repair agent regarding the requirement.
Coordinate and fix timelines for on-site or off-site servicing and arrange for pickup and drop of containers in case of off-site servicing.
Review initial service assessment to see estimated part changes and repairs and authorise repairs.
Inspect containers, post servicing and repairs and check for compliance with requirements; check for errors and take corrective action.
Induct the containers which have cleared repair/service requirements back into service.
Update service/repairs undertaken in ERP and endorse the usage of containers in ERP.

Check with the shipper the requirement regarding the type of cargo and if FCL or LCL is required and recommend the solution with available containers.
Check that necessary precautions and segregation of type of cargo have been considered while allocating LCL containers.
Coordinate with clients and finalise the timelines for container loading and movement.

modules.module_title: Allocate resources for container handling, stuffing and de-stuffing

pcs.pc_description: Obtain the weekly container movement plan and prepare the daily stuffing, de-stuffing and storage plans.
Budget and allocate resources according to the plans.
Conduct morning meetings with staff, equipment handlers and workers to communicate the daily plan and allocate the tasks.
Coordinate with the shipper or transporter to ensure the cargo is available for stuffing.
Oversee that container cargo handling operations are done with all precautions and as per SOP to minimise errors and damages inside and outside the CFS/ ICD/ port terminal.

modules.module_title: Review gate movement of containers and reporting

pcs.pc_description: Check gate logs and entries for container movement into and outside the CFS/ ICD/ port terminals.
Prepare documentation of daily container movement and cargo handling activities.
Update the ERP regarding the container details, location and status.
Provide daily end-of-the-day reports to the manager regarding the status of activities.
